provider.description: Id of the code analysis provider in the registry of pm-core (for example sonar).

commit_sha.description: The commit the provider analysed; for a pull request its head commit at the observation.

status.description: The provider's result mapped to the closed wait dimension analysis_status (Hypermedia Format, Composite Wait).

gate.description: The quality gate of the provider for the target; null when the provider has no gate or has not evaluated one (status running or not_run).

metric.description: The provider's name of what the condition measures.

comparator.description: The condition fails when actual <comparator> threshold holds.

actual.description: null when the provider reports no value.

count_status.description: Whether the count of new issues was established. indeterminate (an unverified scan, an unreadable or paged-off count) makes status undecidable; it never passes.

new_code_issue_count.description: Open issues on new code; null iff count_status == indeterminate.

issues_fetched.description: Issues of this observation read from the provider and filed or matched in the findings ledger.

work_performed.description: Whether this observation changed the findings ledger.

analysis_ref.description: The provider's own identifier of the analysis, for the audit record; never a URL with a credential.
